title: An Engram admission park shows "{agent} was stopped; the queue is paused" and "Authorization is paused. Resume to retry", even when nobody stopped the session and the host is retrying automatically
outcome: The two activity cards say what holds the queue. A park whose automatic re-admission is scheduled says it is retrying automatically, with the attempt and the next time, and asks for no Resume. A hold that does need Resume or Cancel names its cause. The "{agent} was stopped" wording appears only after a real Stop.
acceptance:
2 (test). The paused-queue card (QueuePausedIndicator) states the cause from the session state:
(a) Automatic retry: preview starts with "Engram: waiting for admission; retrying automatically".
- Heading: waiting for Engram admission, retrying automatically.
- Body: the attempt number and the next attempt time, shown in local time, plus the prompts-waiting count.
- It says no action is needed and asks for no Resume.
- If the attempt or time cannot be parsed, it shows the preview text instead, still without asking for Resume.
(b) Held by Engram, needing Resume or Cancel: any other preview that starts with "Engram".
- Heading: Engram is holding the queue.
- Body: the preview text verbatim, which names the cause and the action, plus the count.
(c) Real Stop: preview "Turn stopped by user.". "{agent} was stopped; the queue is paused", with today's body.
(d) Anything else, such as a provider or turn failure or a revoked configuration.
- Heading: the queue is paused.
- Body: the preview text as the cause, plus today's "Send a new prompt or resume the queue to continue."
"{agent} was stopped" appears only in (c).

3 (test). The retained-prompt card, for a retained head that is not interrupted:
- In (a), it says Engram admission is retrying automatically, with the attempt and next time, and that Cancel drops the retained prompt. It does not ask for Resume.
- Otherwise it shows the preview text when the preview starts with "Engram".
- Otherwise it shows "Authorization is held. Resume to retry, or cancel the retained prompt." "Paused" is no longer used for a hold that nobody paused.
The interrupted and source-tracking-recovery texts are unchanged.

4 (test). Only text changes. When each card appears, its buttons and their actions, roles, aria labels and CSS classes are unchanged.
- The cause is resolved by one small pure function in a new module under ui/src/panels/, with its own unit tests for (a) to (d), including an unparseable retry preview.
- Existing tests keep their expectations, except those listed in a provenance note with old and new lines. One is known: the Stop test at AgentSessionPanel.retained-queue.test.tsx:919 asserts "Codex was stopped…" with no preview set. Its fixture gains the real Stop preview "Turn stopped by user.", which the backend sets on Stop.
5 (test). `cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and the full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

6 (judged). Scope: Greg's word (notes da33729a and 82ad4fa6) covers only the card text for the paused-queue and retained-prompt states.
- Changed: ui/src/panels/session-activity-cards.tsx, the retained-card text in ui/src/panels/AgentSessionPanel.tsx, the new module, and tests.
- Not changed: no backend change, no new API field, no change to what holds or releases the queue, no other UI.
- None of w-1df557dae3ac's files is touched while it is in flight. Please confirm those two UI files are not in its frozen set; it is a backend item.

7 (judged). Independent verification: the read-only Codex and Claude review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher, and the acceptance evaluation is made by an evaluator that never held the item.

completion.summary: The paused-queue card and the retained-prompt card now name what holds the queue, from the session preview the backend writes when it pauses it, resolved by a small pure module (ui/src/panels/queue-pause-cause.ts): an automatic Engram re-admission says it is retrying automatically with the attempt and the next local time and asks for nothing; another Engram hold shows Engram's own preview; "{agent} was stopped" appears only after a real Stop; any other cause is shown from the preview under "The queue is paused"; the retained card says "held", not "paused". Text only: card visibility, buttons, roles, aria labels and classes are unchanged. Committed as 84d1f515 (freeze 1, gate test-49e0fba4, pair 1 clean, evaluation 35ea17c2 7/7) and landed by Termal::Opus2 as train 45, merge f7db2c58 on origin/master (train gate test-927e4b07 passed, integration pair clean), with ui/dist deployed and verified live. Follow-ups: w-ee7b6246fb06 (typed pause cause), w-fb6c238b09dc and w-b6f4d5b306f6 (pair-1 Lows), w-48d91aaa9c72 (integration Low).
